name: Decorator
summary: Attaches additional responsibilities to an object dynamically, as a flexible alternative to subclassing for extending behaviour.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Component
roles.summary: Declares the interface shared by the decorated objects and their decorators.

roles.name: ConcreteComponent
roles.summary: The object to which responsibilities can be attached.

roles.name: Decorator
roles.summary: Holds a component and forwards to it, providing the base for concrete decorators.

roles.name: ConcreteDecorator
roles.summary: Adds one responsibility around the component it wraps.
